capability: Credits and cashback on the merchant's sales: the platform gives the merchant back a share of the store's sales, as credit toward the platform's bills or as cashback into the merchant's wallet with the platform, under a plan's or a campaign's terms (Shopify: Earn 1% back on all sales as subscription credits; Zid: cashback campaigns, cashback milestones)
note: Made by the coordinator from the held pass (held/new.tsv, N04, 31 October; held/new-proposals.md). Its place of its own: Shopify's plan table row 'Earn 1% back on all sales' (structures/shopify/pricing-page-data/20261031T003815Z-shopify-com-pricing-by-country/items.jsonl line 91, observed-sh@e38dc17e3; SH-76:124), a plan line, as the concern map's SH-I-1141 and SH-I-1243 are; CM-PLN-001's note makes each plan line evidence for the capability it names, and no cell cited them. Joined across platforms, a reading on role: Zid's dashboard strings pair cashback with campaigns only for Zid's offer to merchants, 'earn a free year subscription and / or cashback' for eligible orders (ZD-7's notes), the merchant's reward for its orders, as Shopify's credit is. Parent CM-PLN-004, platform billing, since Shopify's credit is spent on the platform's bills; CM-PLN-006, the prepaid balance, is the alternative for Zid's wallet. Not CM-LOY-003, cashback to the store's buyers; not Zid's 50% cashback on the annual plan (CM-PLN-002), a return on the plan's price, not on sales (a reading).

Homonyms: not CM-MKT-008, which credits orders to marketing (Q1 placed the scope write_pos_staff_member_event_attribution_overrides, SH-I-2460, in SH-C-131, marketing attribution, by the word), nor CM-B2B-006's sales reps. Where a line is the point of sale's, CM-POS-001 stays beside it.
